purpose: Compile the proven post-publish guide illustration workflow into a deterministic image-attachment playbook for already-prepared place images.

required_inputs.name: published_guide
required_inputs.description: Published guide slug that already contains the target place cards.

required_inputs.name: prepared_images
required_inputs.description: Prepared directory or explicit list of place images mapped to known place IDs.

deterministic_steps.description: Run the existing post-publish asset workflow in missing-only mode.
deterministic_steps.expected_outcome: matched place images and safe place image patch bundle

deterministic_steps.description: Run the narrow checks needed for deterministic image attachment.
deterministic_steps.command: npm run content:lint && npm run images:check
deterministic_steps.expected_outcome: image references and derivative manifest remain valid

deterministic_steps.description: Record a compact MEDIA_ASSETS_ATTACHED event and routine evidence without portfolio mutation.

FULL: full repository validation because structure or code changed
CRITICAL: security or infrastructure review with explicit approval gate

expected_outputs: place images attached to the published guide
allowed_changes: place image fields for known place IDs
public guide image files and generated derivatives
compact event and evidence files in ABVX-OS
prohibited_changes: portfolio state mutation from routine success
manual place remapping without explicit escalation
escalation_conditions: unexpected missing or duplicate place IDs
